text:
Asking rents in Potsdam stand at a median of 14.55 €/m² (2026-06), up 8.0% on the year and +30.2% over five years. That ranks Potsdam #7 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 85% above the 2022 average contract rent of 7.85 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 873 € a month in cold rent, 19.2% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 22 days and 40% are gone within a week; with 1.3% market-active vacancy and +5.4% population growth over five years, the market looks tight.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 15.35 €/m² (+5.5%), with an 80% range of 14.64 to 15.72 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
